rear_service_overhang_note: The rear service block has a 0.575 mm rear projection beyond the solar-roof backing, plus narrow side margins; its vertical solid depth is 3.22 mm. The air gap below the rear projection is 1.84 mm. It is checked as a thick short cantilever with a continuous forward root, not falsely described as vertically solid to the base at every point.
method: Unmodified STL triangles, original winding normals and face IDs; local-normal rays start 0.0001 mm outside the surface. The first solid interval is checked by independent generic-direction parity at outside/inside surface points, its midpoint and after its exit. Centroids cover every original face. Selected architectural surfaces add seven barycentric probes per triangle. Short chords are not discarded: every one is independently localized to shallow backed relief or grounded step/terrace corner using retained directional root rays.
scope_limitations: This is a finite sampling audit, not a mathematical continuous global minimum-wall certificate.
Shallow relief edges can have very small local-normal chords: minimum recorded 0.046001 mm; their independent supporting material is checked, but visual print resolution is not guaranteed.
No physical print, Cura/Prusa toolpath or support-free claim.
Use with the separate topology, layer-contour, per-Polygon erosion/opening, exact-rebuild and saved-scene checks.
